title: Home Boarding
excerpt: A loving family home instead of kennels. Daycare is included in the price, so your dog has company, walks and play every day you're away.
intro: Home boarding is a loving alternative to kennels. Your dog stays in our family home, not a noisy, unfamiliar environment. Our boarding price includes our daycare service, so while you're away your dog enjoys daily walks, playtime, cuddles and their usual routine, with plenty of one-to-one attention.
highlights: Licensed by Rushmoor Borough Council (Licence No. 25/00868/AWRHOM)
Daycare included in the boarding price
Your dog lives as part of our family, with a secure 100ft garden
We board up to 3 dogs at a time, alongside our own
Less stress and less exposure to infections such as kennel cough than kennels
Especially suitable for older dogs, small breeds and rescues
Discounts for more than one dog from the same household
pricingNote: Spaces fill quickly, especially over holidays and weekends. Every dog completes a trial stay or daycare session before a longer booking. Please bring your dog's usual food. We have plenty of beds, bowls and toys, but you're welcome to bring their own. Home boarding cancellations need 4 weeks' notice.
notes: We cannot accept entire males (unless young pups) due to our licensing conditions.
Unneutered females cannot stay while in season.
We are unable to board dogs with aggressive tendencies towards people or other dogs, as they share our family home.
